description: This file contains utility functions and classes related to HR management in an ERPNext-based system, including employee data handling, date validation, leave management, and external integrations.

classes.name: DuplicateDeclarationError
classes.description: Custom validation error class for duplicate records in payroll exemptions or similar contexts.

methods.name: set_employee_name(doc)
methods.description: Sets the employee name in a document if the employee ID is provided and name is missing.

methods.name: update_employee_work_history(employee, details, date=None, cancel=False)
methods.description: Updates or appends an employee's internal work history based on provided details and handles cancellation scenario.

methods.name: delete_employee_work_history(details, employee, date)
methods.description: Deletes employee work history entries matching given criteria and date.

methods.name: get_employee_fields_label()
methods.description: Returns a list of specific employee fields with labels for external use.

methods.name: get_employee_field_property(employee, fieldname)
methods.description: Fetches and formats the property of a specific employee field, including its value and options.

methods.name: validate_dates(doc, from_date, to_date)
methods.description: Validates that a date range is logical and within employee employment period.

methods.name: validate_overlap(doc, from_date, to_date, company = None)
methods.description: Checks for overlapping records within a date range for specific documents.

methods.name: throw_overlap_error(doc, exists_for, overlap_doc, from_date, to_date)
methods.description: Throws an error if overlapping records are detected.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_exemption_for_payroll_period(doctype, docname, payroll_period, employee)
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate exemption record exists for the same employee and period.

methods.name: validate_tax_declaration(declarations)
methods.description: Validates that tax exemptions do not have duplicate subcategories.

methods.name: get_total_exemption_amount(declarations)
methods.description: Calculates total exemption amount across multiple declarations, respecting category max limits.

methods.name: get_leave_period(from_date, to_date, company)
methods.description: Fetches active leave periods overlapping a given date range.

methods.name: generate_leave_encashment()
methods.description: Automatically generates leave encashment records when enabled.

methods.name: allocate_earned_leaves()
methods.description: Allocates earned leaves based on employee eligibility and policies.

methods.name: update_previous_leave_allocation(allocation, annual_allocation, e_leave_type)
methods.description: Updates or creates leave allocations, considering leave policies and rounding rules.

methods.name: get_monthly_earned_leave(annual_leaves, frequency, rounding)
methods.description: Calculates earned leaves per month based on annual allocation, frequency, and rounding.

methods.name: get_leave_allocations(date, leave_type)
methods.description: Retrieves leave allocations within a specified date and leave type.

methods.name: get_earned_leaves()
methods.description: Fetches list of earned leave types with their configurations.

methods.name: create_additional_leave_ledger_entry(allocation, leaves, date)
methods.description: Creates ledger entries for leave adjustments.

methods.name: check_effective_date(from_date, to_date, frequency, based_on_date_of_joining_date)
methods.description: Determines if a date aligns with policy-based effective date checks for recurring leave.

methods.name: get_salary_assignment(employee, date)
methods.description: Fetches the latest salary structure assignment for an employee on a given date.

methods.name: get_sal_slip_total_benefit_given(employee, payroll_period, component=False)
methods.description: Calculates total flexible benefit amount paid to an employee in a payroll period.

methods.name: get_holiday_dates_for_employee(employee, start_date, end_date)
methods.description: Returns a list of holiday dates within a range for the employee.

methods.name: get_holidays_for_employee(employee, start_date, end_date, raise_exception=True, only_non_weekly=False)
methods.description: Fetches detailed holiday objects for an employee within a date range.

methods.name: calculate_annual_eligible_hra_exemption(doc)
methods.description: Stub for regional HRA exemption calculation (Indian localization).

methods.name: calculate_hra_exemption_for_period(doc)
methods.description: Stub for regional HRA exemption calculation for a period.

methods.name: get_previous_claimed_amount(employee, payroll_period, non_pro_rata=False, component=False)
methods.description: Calculates total benefit claim amounts for an employee over a period.

methods.name: share_doc_with_approver(doc, user)
methods.description: Shares a document with a user if they lack permission, and removes share on change.

methods.name: validate_active_employee(employee)
methods.description: Ensures transactions are not created for inactive employees.

methods.name: get_doc_condition(doctype)
methods.description: unavailable
